To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the multi-component reactions of acetoacetaniline derivatives 1 with various aromatic aldehydes and malononitriile or ethyl cyanoate in the presence of either triethylamine or ammonium acetate as catalyst gave the 1H-pyran and 4H-pyrane 4, 1,4 dihydropyridine and 4-hydropyridone derivatives 5, 9, 11, respectively.

the multi-component reaction of acetoacetanide derivative with aromatic aldehydes and cyanomethylene reagents in the presence of catalytic amount of base or acid gave 4H-pyrans and 1, 4-dihydpirydines derivatives.
the newly developed compounds showed potent anti-tumor activities against six human cancer cell lines.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of a new series of pyran derivatives 4 and 7, and 1, 4-dihypridines 5 and 9, as well as the synthesis of aryl hydrazones derivatives 11.
the synthesis and anti-tumor activities of 4H-pyrans, 1,4 dihydropyridine and arylhydrazones derivatives.

the synthesis of new 4H-pyrans and 1, 4-dihydroridines from the multi-component reaction of acetoacetaniline derivatives, aromatic aldehydes, and cyanomethylene reagents in the presence of different catalysts.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
compounds 4, 5, 7, 9 and aryl hydrazones 11 are good candidates for the development of new antitumor drugs.
the synthesized 4H-pyrans 4a-g and 1, 4-dihydrouridines 5a-f are potential anti-cancer agents with high selectivity.
4a, f and 9a are the most active compounds against the six human cancer cell lines and 4f is the most active compound with the least toxicity to the shrimp larvae.

we have successfully synthesized a series of 4H-pyrans, 1,4- dihydropyridine and their derivatives.
we have developed a simple, efficient, one-pot, multi-component reaction to produce 4H-pyrans, dihydropyridines, and aryl hydrazone derivatives with anti-tumor activity.
the newly synthesized compounds are potential anti-cancer agents.
